scope: Segment DL4 host-originated, separator-free, self-delimited ('@' ... '~') software-download schedule for devices loaded through the BUYPASS device management system by dial; carried together with DL5 in the Software Load Response
extractionEvidence: regression-artifact-validator/specifications/ATL105/docs/specs/extracted_text.txt lines 17363-17445 (Section 12.45), 9455-9580 (Section 11.7.4 Software Load), 6166-6200 (Section 10.10 Software Update Processing Requirements), 20690-20697, 21575-21660 (Section 13.2 Elements 57, 91, 92, 93, 94, 95)

rules.title: Segment DL4 is used to download an application from a BUYPASS-supported device management system; vendors who support their own applications do NOT use this segment
Segment DL4 maximum length is 52 alphanumeric characters; originates at BUYPASS (Host); Data Type Indicator fixed '@' (field 1), End-of-Data Indicator fixed '~' (last field)
rules.note: 52 = '@' + 8 + 13 + 18 + 6 + 4 + 1 + '~' (Software Load Phone Number at its 18-character maximum).

rules.title: New Software Version(57,8), Software Terminal Record ID(95,13), Software Load Phone Number(91,18), Software Load Request Date(92,6), Software Load Request Time(93,4), Software Load Type(94,1) are all required, Host-sourced
Segment DL4 fields are not separated by Field Separators; when a field is not populated, the next field immediately follows
rules.note: Software Load Phone Number is variable length up to 18 but is followed by a fixed-width date without a separator; the parse boundary is open (SEGDL4-SME-003).

rules.title: New Software Version (57) and Software Terminal Record ID (95) are fixed-length AN 8 and AN 13; Software Load Phone Number (91) is AN up to 18; Software Load Request Date (92) is MMDDYY; Software Load Request Time (93) is HHMM; Software Load Type (94) is 'F' (full application load) or 'P' (partial application load)

Segment DL4 is Required in the Software Load Response (Data Block No. 1, after the Start-of-Data Block Indicator ')'), is sent together with Segment DL5 (also Required), and is sent only on a Software Load Response; the load requires merchant load flag SOFT, otherwise only an error message block and a terminating block are returned
rules.note: DL4 and DL5 are co-sent, not mutually exclusive. 10.10 step 4 places them in the response to a Table Load request instead (SEGDL4-SME-002).

rules.title: Software update processing: a bit on the merchant profile makes BUYPASS return Download Indicator 1 on the next transaction response; the device requests a load; BUYPASS returns DL4 and DL5; the device stores New Software Version, Software Terminal Record ID, Software Load Phone Number or IP/URL Address, Request Date and Request Time; at that date and time the device dials the Software Load Phone Number and requests a full application load; afterwards it requests a Table Load, which BUYPASS sends without the profile bit
The device can attempt the automated full application load at most three times; if a load request to the Software Load Phone Number is unsuccessful, the device prints the 'decline' message
rules.note: Device behaviour after DL4 is received; observable only through device logs or the absence of further load attempts.
